neighbours.label: step-by-step computer usage instructions (do a right-click, type the command, open the file); the pole tracks the how-to-on-a-computer context
fire: To rename it, select the file and do a slow double click on its name.
Then type cd followed by the folder name to move into that directory.
Press Ctrl and C together to copy the selected text to the clipboard.
Go to the Settings menu and choose Reset to restore the default layout.
Run the cat command on the log file to see what the server printed.
Drag the icon onto the desktop to create a shortcut for the program.
Use the mount command to attach the USB drive to the folder /mnt.
Right-click the folder, then pick Properties to check its size.
quiet: To prune it, select the branch and make a slow clean cut near the bud.
Then pour the batter into the pan and move it into the hot oven.
Press the dough and fold it together until the surface looks smooth.
Go to the front desk and ask for a key to restore your room access.
Ask the waiter about the soup to see what the kitchen prepared today.
Drag the chair onto the porch to create a reading spot in the sun.
Use the long ladder to reach the gutter above the back window.
Open the cupboard, then pick a bowl to check its size.
